$comment: What a call that throws ends in, on both hosts: the code the caller is handed and, where the plugin's own code stands, its message. Each case's `call` is handed to raised-plugin.js's `raise`. Both hosts run it over a transport that answers `redirectsToItself` with a 302 to itself, `answersTooLarge` with one byte more than limits.json's responseBodyBytes, and fails every other request, as a server that does not answer. test/raised.test.js walks it through the CLI's engine and PluginRaisedRecordTest through the device's runtime. A case with no `message` compares none, because the two hosts word METHOD_THREW and a failed transport differently. Add a case when a thrown value turns out to matter.

cases.why: unreachable carries its code and the plugin's sentence
unreachable's reason is optional
unreachable is the plugin's word: hand-built, it stands with no host function having failed in the call
challenged carries its code and the URL that answered with a check
challenged is the plugin's word too: hand-built with the URL that answered with a check, it stands and carries the URL, and the host decides above it whether the viewer is offered a browser
unreachable stands after the host refused a request in the same call, and is not taken for the host's verdict
notFound is honoured
unauthenticated is honoured
unavailable is honoured
misconfigured is honoured
a code no host knows is the plugin's own failure
a server that did not answer is REQUEST_FAILED, the host's code, let through the call
a request the plugin built wrong is REQUEST_INVALID, the host's code, let through the call
a redirect chain the host gave up on is REDIRECT_REFUSED, the host's code, let through the call
cases.message: more than 20 redirects, ending at https://loop.test/

cases.why: a plugin cannot claim REQUEST_INVALID, a host code, when no host function gave it
a plugin cannot claim REDIRECT_REFUSED, a host code, when no host function gave it
a value the store will not keep is STORE_REFUSED, the host's code, let through the call; never REQUEST_FAILED
cases.message: yonto.store.set refused: the key is 1025 characters, over the 1024 a store keeps

cases.why: a plugin cannot claim STORE_REFUSED, a host code, when no host function gave it
a body over the limit is RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE, the host's code, let through the call; never REQUEST_FAILED, since the server answered
cases.message: the response from https://large.test/ was larger than the 16 MB a plugin may read

cases.why: a plugin cannot claim RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE, a host code, when no host function gave it
